# Yuzu Hair & Beauty

Yuzu Hair & Beauty is a Japanese-inspired hair salon at 5 Dickens Yard, Longfield Avenue, Ealing, London W5 2TD, a short walk from Ealing Broadway station. Services: cuts, blow-dries, colour, balayage, Brazilian blow-dry. Open Tue–Fri 10:00–20:00, Sat 09:00–18:00. Monday and Sunday closed. Phone 020 8840 2244. Email info@yuzuhairandbeauty.co.uk. Book online: https://www.phorest.com/salon/yuzuhairandbeauty
